capabilities: Capture clipboard URLs as references with auto-detected types
Cycle reference statuses and stamp completion dates
Browse all vault references in a filterable, sortable map
Edit, delete, or open the reference under the cursor
Find references that point to missing notes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. References are stored as plain two-line Markdown entries under a ## References heading, so they remain readable without the plugin.
problem: Links saved across notes make it hard to remember what you have read, what is in progress, and where each reference lives.
summary: Reference tracker that captures URLs as typed, statused, and rated Markdown entries in notes and lists them all in a vault-wide map.
